against.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Sep 8 it closed under the Aug 17 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) are intact.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and losing the last higher low breaks it.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 in its buy zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Jan 2, 2024 to Dec 2, 2024 (+184%, wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+0.8% to −18%), with the 50-week average and the 200-week average in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−41%); a close over the wave-1 high (+68%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
